title: Unclamping the busk of her stays

anchor.text: unclamping the busk of her stays
anchor.prefix: me raking up the fire and frying up those pieces of lap of mutton for her supper with the Chutney sauce she liked. And the mulled rum. Could see her in the bedroom from the hearth
anchor.suffix:
. White. 

 Swish and soft flop her stays made on the bed. Always warm from her. Always liked to let her self out. Sitting there after till near two taking out her hairpins. Milly
anchor.canonical_text: unclamping the busk of her stays
